links.comparator_used: Original static ELDER-ICU model without updating (external validation as-is)
links.outcome: Discrimination (AUROC) and calibration for in-hospital mortality prediction in critically ill older adults across 12 international centers
links.effect: Incremental training enhanced performance in most centers; retraining improved AUROC by 0.066 (South Korea) and 0.076 (China) versus original AUROC of 0.753 and 0.698; isotonic regression and Platt scaling improved calibration globally
links.quote: Incremental training enhanced performance in most centers, while retraining significantly improved AUROC by 0.066 and 0.076 in the two Asian sites (South Korea and China, respectively).

design_hint: local validation and recalibration/updating before go-live
